It is a collection of skills and tools that lets an AI coding agent reverse engineer any PC game you own to make real, working modifications. It finds the game files, figures out the engine, and writes the code to add new features, all while keeping your original save data safe. The coolest part? It generates the art, 3D models, and sound effects directly into the game's format, so your new character or weapon looks native. You don't need to be a programmer; you just describe the mod, and the AI handles the heavy lifting.
